actions.diff:
--- a/base58/__init__.py
+++ b/base58/__init__.py
@@ -149,6 +149,16 @@
-    while i:
-        # Remaining groups one at a time; zero digits at the top of the
-        # last group are removed by the lstrip below
-        i, rem = divmod(i, big)
-        parts += pairs[rem % sq], pairs[rem // sq]
-    parts.reverse()
+    # At most three groups remain. The top group is i itself once i is
+    # below big, so it needs no divmod; zero digits at the top of it are
+    # removed by the lstrip below
+    if i >= big:
+        i, rem = divmod(i, big)
+        if i >= big:
+            i, rem2 = divmod(i, big)
+            parts += (pairs[rem % sq], pairs[rem // sq],
+                      pairs[rem2 % sq], pairs[rem2 // sq],
+                      pairs[i % sq], pairs[i // sq])
+        else:
+            parts += (pairs[rem % sq], pairs[rem // sq],
+                      pairs[i % sq], pairs[i // sq])
+    elif i:
+        parts += pairs[i % sq], pairs[i // sq]
+    parts.reverse()
